Q5779.reason: Common UK guidance is to flush a peripheral cannula at least every 8 hours, and the team note's 4-hour figure doesn't match the standard I know.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), once bidding has begun at a without-reserve auction, the goods cannot be withdrawn unless no bid is made within a reasonable time, so the woman's $100 bid binds the man.

Q6156.reason: The company's attorney took the deposition and had the opportunity and a similar motive to examine the engineer, so FRE 804(b)(1) former testimony applies to the unavailable witness.
